events.name: Houston Rockets at Los Angeles Lakers

headlines.description: — LeBron James had 28 points, eight rebounds and seven assists, and the short-handed Los Angeles Lakers outlasted the Houston Rockets for a 101-94 victory Tuesday night and a stunning 2-0 lead in their first-round playoff series.
headlines.shortLinkText: LeBron scores 28, leads short-handed Lakers past Durant's Rockets again 101-94 for 2-0 series lead
